_meta.what: What the shop sells as card packs. A pack's cards are in data/cards.json like any other, but are dealt into a game only when someone at the table owns the pack, and show locked in a collection until the player owns it. A card is in one pack at most; a card in no pack is in every game.
_meta.fields: id is what a purchase and a game's settings refer to, so never change one. cover is the picture on the shelf, cost is in coins, cards lists ids, releasedAt is the day it went on sale.
